diagrams.title: Two set languages → one CDN
diagrams.description: Pokedata and images.pokemontcg.io use different identifiers for the same card. setToSetCode() bridges them.
diagrams.mermaid:
flowchart LR
  subgraph PD["Pokedata language"]
    PD_ID["card id: 59268"]
    PD_NAME["set_name: Vivid Voltage"]
    PD_NUM["num: 025"]
    PD_SET["set_id / set_code"]
  end
  subgraph MAP["setToSetCode()"]
    JSON["pokemonTcgSets.json\nnameToId"]
    STATIC["App static maps\nSET_NAME_TO_CODE…"]
  end
  subgraph CDN["CDN language"]
    CODE["set code: swsh4"]
    NUM["number: 025"]
    URL["images.pokemontcg.io/\nswsh4/025_hires.png"]
  end
  PD_NAME --> JSON
  PD_NAME --> STATIC
  PD_SET --> STATIC
  JSON --> CODE
  STATIC --> CODE
  PD_NUM --> URL
  CODE --> URL

flows.name: Two set languages → one CDN
flows.description: Pokedata and images.pokemontcg.io use different identifiers for the same product. Mapping turns set names, numeric ids, or short codes into the official TCG set code (e.g. swsh4) used in the image URL.
flows.example: Pokedata: set_name "Vivid Voltage", num "025" → setToSetCode → swsh4 → https://images.pokemontcg.io/swsh4/025_hires.png

steps.title: 1. Pokedata speaks its own language
steps.detail: Search/card API returns id (59268), set_name ("Vivid Voltage"), num (025), sometimes set_id (557) or set_code (SWSH04). These are for pricing and identity — not CDN paths.

steps.title: 2. CDN speaks set code + number
steps.detail: images.pokemontcg.io only accepts official Pokémon TCG API set ids: /{setCode}/{number}_hires.png (e.g. swsh4/025).

steps.title: 3. setToSetCode() bridges them
steps.detail: App: pokemonTcgSetCodes.ts tries pokemonTcgSets.json nameToId, then static SET_NAME_TO_CODE, SET_ID_TO_CODE, POKEDATA_SET_CODE_TO_TCG. Server: setCodeMap.ts uses JSON only (copy json to dist on build).

steps.title: 4. buildImageUrl / getPokemonTcgImageUrl*
steps.detail: Server lookup.ts and app pokemonTcgImages.ts assemble the CDN URL. If setId is null in DB but setName exists, server resolves from setName on cache read.

steps.title: 5. Sets not on CDN
steps.detail: App SET_CODES_NOT_ON_CDN (asc, pfl): client skips building a 404 URL; use server imageUrl from API or placeholder. Refresh sets: pnpm run fetch-tcg-sets in server.

flows.name: Profile collection card image
flows.description: Portfolio grid artwork comes from the server when possible; the app only builds CDN URLs as fallback.
flows.example: GET collections → cardImageUrl → ProductGrid Image { uri }

steps.title: 1. GET /api/profile/collections
steps.detail: Server joins collections with card_prices. Builds cardImageUrl: stored imageUrl, else buildImageUrl(collection.set || prices.setId || prices.setName, cardNumber).

steps.title: 2. App waterfall
steps.detail: cardImageUrl → getPokemonTcgImageUrlFromSetNumberIfOnCdn(set, number) → getPokemonTcgImageUrl(cardId) if id looks like swsh4-025 → collection.image (Cloudinary) → CARD_PLACEHOLDER_IMAGE.

steps.title: 3. No Pokedata on every profile load
steps.detail: Prices/images come from card_prices if last_fetched_at < 48h. Pokedata is called only when cache miss/stale or user adds a card with cardId.

flows.name: Pokedata price + image cache
flows.description: getCardLookupOrFetch stores pricing and resolved image URL in card_prices for 48 hours.

cacheLayers.what: marketPrice, setName, setId, cardNumber, imageUrl, last_fetched_at
cacheLayers.persist: Permanent row per Pokedata card id

steps.title: 1. Cache hit
steps.detail: Return from DB; imageUrl rebuilt from setName if setId was null.

steps.title: 2. Cache miss / stale
steps.detail: Call Pokedata pricing API; map set_name via setToSetCode; UPSERT card_prices and daily card_price_history.

steps.detail: ImagePicker returns file:// or blob:. isExternalUrl() is false — must upload.

steps.title: 2. uploadImage()
steps.detail: Base64 POST to DOMAIN/images/upload-base64 with Bearer session.

steps.title: 3. Store URL
steps.detail: collections.image, listing photos, profile avatar — https://res.cloudinary.com/...
